evidence.title: GitHub - noegarsoux/GradientGen: GradientGen is a free & open-source gradient creation tool.

name: GradientGen
summary: Browser app that generates vector-field gradients with grain, scanlines and posterize effects, exported up to 4096px.
description: Single-page gradient generator (v1.0) that renders gradients from a vector field: movement mode, scale, phase, velocity, detail, twist and speed controls; hue, saturation, vibrance, brightness, contrast, RGB multipliers and color offset for the palette; grain, posterize and scanlines for texture. Output resolution is selectable up to 4096px. The interface is in French, and the project is free and open source under BSD-3-Clause.
contains: movement, scale, phase, velocity, detail, twist and speed controls
color controls: hue, saturation, vibrance, brightness, contrast, RGB multipliers, color offset
free and open source; 67 stars and 12 forks on GitHub
